main_text.p: quam veritas pateat, & cum jam pa-tuerit, præfumtæ defensio falsitatis.
Faxit Deus, ne in peccatis evanidam voluptatem, cum conscientiæ tormentis coniunctam, unquam feſtemur[?].
main_text.head: VERSVS XII.

p.i: Va ædificanti urbem sanguine, & ei qui stabilit civitatem iniquitate.

main_text.p: Exclamatio est, qua amplificatur rei indignitas.
Quæ res ad destruendas urbes potissimum faciunt, eæ non citra summum me-tis errorem ad eas exstruendas adhibentur: ut ex repugnantium rerum natura liquet.

Sanguinis autem iniuste fusi, & fudoris pauperum servientium alienæ magnificentiæ, copia & effusio facit ad destruendas urbes: Ezech.24.9. Nah.3.1.[?] Econtrà iustitia & æquitate superiorum erga inferiores, & horum erga illos egregia fide & officijs, ædificantur palatia bonorum Principum & urbes.
Itaque res ipsa docet, Nebucadneza-rem & Chaldæos toto cœlo errare, cum urbes præclaras sanguine, fudore ac la-bori-

page.notes: The word "feftemur" in the Faxit line is hard to read; it may be a printing error for a different verb, and the reading is marked [?]. "Nah.3.1." is partly unclear and marked [?]. The bold "Va" opening the verse is printed as shown, without an added final letter. The last line ends with the hyphenated "bori-" at the foot of the page, and the word continues on the next page. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
